ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity central region extending from the peduncle to the median notch. High-intensity (white) regions are mapped to the distal one-third of both lobes, featuring irregular, mottled boundaries where they interface with the black central area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a distinct apex; estimated internal angle of 75 degrees with a vertical depth approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, high-amplitude jaggedness; notable deep, non-uniform pixel valleys are present on the distal portion of the left lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning into upwardly swept, acute lateral tips; leading edge exhibits a smooth convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark, circular pixel groups (scars) approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter, concentrated within the high-intensity white field of the right distal lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct series of dark, roughly parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the white distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular structural indentation (tissue loss) on the trailing edge of the left lobe, creating a distinctively asymmetrical profile compared to the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Complex 'salt-and-pepper' pixel distribution at the transitional boundary between the black inner fluke and white outer fluke on the left lobe.
